instruction: In saa-format-guide.pptx, change the font color of the 'FHSS Writing Lab' text on slide 1 to red.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the PPTX file from /home/user/Desktop/saa-format-guide.pptx and targets slide index 0 (slide 1), matching the instruction.
Getter searches for a shape containing 'FHSS Writing Lab' (case-insensitive) and extracts explicit RGB font color from a run, correctly addressing the target text.
Metric compares the extracted color against FF0000 (red) with a tolerance of 10 per RGB channel, which is semantically correct for the 'change to red' requirement.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads the updated file state.
Negative control should work correctly: initial white or unset color will either return explicit FFFFFF (fails FF0000 check) or return an error (metric returns 0.0).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The getter returns only the FIRST run with an explicit color in the matching shape. If 'FHSS Writing Lab' spans multiple runs and only some are set to red, the evaluator may return 1.0 prematurely. Consider checking all runs and returning only if all have red color, or checking the last run.

If the user applies a theme-based red color (not an explicit RGB), run.font.color.rgb raises an exception which is caught and skipped, potentially returning an error (false negative). This is an unlikely edge case for standard LibreOffice usage but worth noting.
